notes: Security questionnaire / vendor risk intake summary — focused on Private VPC deployment details and SIG/CAIQ mapping.

SIG status: Mariner requested full SIG v3.1. Redwood has provided SIG-lite + CAIQ baseline; customer expects full SIG by 2024-11-10. Mariner requires explicit answers for KMS, key custody, and privileged access.

KMS integration: Customer mandate is BYOK with customer-managed keys in a customer KMS (HSM-backed). Redwood response: private control plane supports customer KMS integration and can accept customer keys via secure API, but Mariner needs: (1) KMS integration guide, (2) key rotation policy, (3) HSM attestation evidence. Action: Redwood to deliver KMS integration doc + sample API calls.

Data residency: Primary requirement is to contain EU/CA PII in eu-west-1 and ca-central-1. Must ensure no cross-region egress for sensitive flows; allowed fallback only after explicit approval. Need regional tenancy SLA and proof of region pinning for model serving.

Audit logging: Mariner requires tamper-evident, immutable audit logs with 7-year retention and chain-of-custody reporting. Redwood outlined streaming logs to customer S3 or SIEM via secure syslog/HTTPS. Mariner legal requests architecture diagram showing immutability guarantees and retention controls (write-once/read-many? object lock?).

Shared responsibility: Draft matrix shared. Customer owns data classification, redaction, IAM, and application-level PII minimization. Redwood owns infrastructure, runtime security, kernel patching, and model execution. Mariner wants explicit contractual language around KV cache purge at session termination and logs redaction policies.

Vendor risk intake asks: SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert, penetration test summary, CAIQ mapping. Mariner security team will run these through a third-party VRM; timeline target 2 weeks after receiving documents.

POC acceptance criteria (technical): chat latency <120ms (95th) for 256-token sessions; embeddings throughput 500 QPS with configured batching; encryption-in-transit and at-rest using customer KMS; audit log delivery to customer SIEM within 60s. POC test harness and evaluation prompts documented in Drive (drive:/Mariner/POC/test-harness-v1.zip).

Commercials: Mariner requests a quote for 2-node private deployment + enterprise support + on-boarding services. Ask for cost breakdown: reserved capacity, burst option, and optional longer log retention add-on.
Quote from CTO Anika Rao: "We can't accept a black-box KMS — need BYOK and auditable key lifecycle."

Open questions listed by Mariner: (1) Can Redwood guarantee no model artifacts leave the VPC? (2) Is there a signed SLA for data residency and cross-region fallback? (3) What level of access will Redwood ops have to customer VPC resources?
